note: Explicit user selections for the three product choices left unresolved in 04-CONTEXT.md <deferred>. Responses are recorded verbatim as supplied by the user. Recommendations were never treated as consent.

toolbar.response: Distinct icons (proposed) — Five static shape treatments in 32x32 PNG: check = working (incl. blank column), column-plus = confirmed missing Priority column, question mark = cannot read view, hollow circle = checking/unavailable, power symbol = off. Three diagnoses stay exactly three; off/neutral describe operation, not a fourth diagnosis. Explanatory action titles, never colour alone. Store artwork stays Phase 5.

preference.response: Global, storage.local (proposed) — Persist only {enabled: boolean} in chrome.storage.local; a missing key means true. The current tab must acknowledge cleanup/reconciliation; other runnable tabs converge via storage.onChanged; frozen tabs re-read on resume. Survives browser restart in both states. Delivery is asynchronous — no promise of atomic application across frozen tabs.
